name: Ospren
title: The Crown's Timber Buyer
examine: Silverfall's man, in Silverfall's good coat, on his fourth winter of promising himself it is his last.
lines: Stig wants ridgepoles, Dagny wants staves, Haki wants shafts. Nobody wants to hear about the grain.
I buy one tree in a hundred and I am hated for the ninety-nine.
There is a hall in Silverfall with a roof I bought. I have not stood under it.
